mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_task (tenant_id, task_no, prompt, duration_sec, resolution, format, aspect_ratio, status, idempotency_key, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskNo}, #{prompt}, #{durationSec}, #{resolution}, #{format}, #{aspectRatio}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE video_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING')
